```{r}
library(DT)
library(tidyverse)
library(SPEI)
library(drought)
library(extRemes)
library(heatwaveR)
library(lubridate)
library(fitdistrplus)
```
# Loading the Data


```{r}
data <- readRDS("/Users/mandarphatak/Documents/GitHub/Climate-Analysis/DWD_Folder/Data_DWD/Hamburg_Fuhlsbüttel.rds")


data <- data |> drop_na()
monthly_tbl <- data |> 
  dplyr::mutate(year = year(date),
         month = month(date)) |> 
  group_by(year, month) |> 
  summarize(
    prec = sum(prec, na.rm = TRUE),
    Tavg = mean(Tavg, na.rm = TRUE),
    Tmin = mean(Tmin, na.rm = TRUE),
    Tmax = mean(Tmax, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |> 
 dplyr:: mutate(date = make_date(year, month)) |> 
  dplyr::select(year, month, date, prec:Tmax)

monthly_tbl <- monthly_tbl |> drop_na()
```
## From previous analysis we already know that Hargreaves method is suitable for PET
```{r}
## PEt calculation
monthly_tbl <- monthly_tbl |> 
  mutate(PET = hargreaves(Tmin = monthly_tbl$Tmin,Tmax = monthly_tbl$Tmax,Pre = monthly_tbl$prec,lat = 53.6332)) |> 
  rename(PREC = prec)
## Balance Computation
monthly_tbl$BAL <- monthly_tbl$PREC - monthly_tbl$PET
# Converting the monthly to ts format for convenience 
monthly_tbl <- ts(monthly_tbl[,-c(1,2,3)], start = c(1936,01), end = c(2025,05), frequency = 12)
plot_dir <- "/Users/mandarphatak/Documents/GitHub/Climate-Analysis/DWD_Folder/Plots"
```

#### SPEI Index 
```{r}

# SPEI series 3,6,9,12,24,36,48
spei_3 <- spei(monthly_tbl[,"BAL"],3)
spei_6 <- spei(monthly_tbl[,"BAL"],6)
spei_9 <- spei(monthly_tbl[,"BAL"],9)
spei_12 <- spei(monthly_tbl[,"BAL"],12)
spei_24 <- spei(monthly_tbl[,"BAL"],24)
spei_36 <- spei(monthly_tbl[,"BAL"],36)
spei_48 <- spei(monthly_tbl[,"BAL"],48)



date_seq <- seq.Date(from = as.Date("1936-01-01"), 
                     to = as.Date("2025-05-01"), 
                     by = "month")

spei_3 <- spei_3$fitted |> as_tibble()
spei_6 <- spei_6$fitted |> as_tibble()
spei_9 <- spei_9$fitted |> as_tibble()
spei_12 <- spei_12$fitted |> as_tibble()
spei_24<- spei_24$fitted |> as_tibble()
spei_36 <- spei_36$fitted |> as_tibble()
spei_48 <- spei_48$fitted |> as_tibble()
spei_3tbl <- data.frame(date = date_seq, Value = spei_3)
spei_6tbl <- data.frame(date = date_seq, Value = spei_6)
spei_9tbl <- data.frame(date = date_seq, Value = spei_9)
spei_12tbl <- data.frame(date = date_seq, Value = spei_12)
spei_24tbl <- data.frame(date = date_seq, Value = spei_24)
spei_36tbl <- data.frame(date = date_seq, Value = spei_36)
spei_48tbl <- data.frame(date = date_seq, Value = spei_48)

colnames(spei_3tbl) <- c("date","spei_3")
colnames(spei_6tbl) <- c("date","spei_6")
colnames(spei_9tbl) <- c("date","spei_9")
colnames(spei_12tbl) <- c("date","spei_12")
colnames(spei_24tbl) <- c("date","spei_24")
colnames(spei_36tbl) <- c("date","spei_36")
colnames(spei_48tbl) <- c("date","spei_48")

spei_12tbl <- spei_12tbl |> drop_na()
spei_24tbl <- spei_24tbl |> drop_na()
spei_36tbl <- spei_36tbl |> drop_na()
spei_48tbl <- spei_48tbl |> drop_na()
```

# SPEI 12 1936-1989
```{r fig.align='center', fig.width=15, fig.height=10}
library(shadowtext)
library(ggplot2)
library(lubridate)
spei_12tbl <- spei_12tbl |> filter(date <"1990-01-01")
# Fixed classification with proper handling of NA values and non-overlapping ranges
spei_12tbl <- spei_12tbl |> 
  mutate(
    drought_category = case_when(
      spei_12 >= 2.0                       ~ "Extremely Wet",
      spei_12 >= 1.5 & spei_12 < 2.0       ~ "Significantly Wet",
      spei_12 >= 1.0 & spei_12 < 1.5       ~ "Moderately Wet",
      spei_12 >= 0.0 & spei_12 < 1.0       ~ "Near Normal (Slightly Wet)",
      spei_12 >= -1.0 & spei_12 < 0.0      ~ "Near Normal (Slightly Dry)",
      spei_12 >= -1.5 & spei_12 < -1.0     ~ "Moderate Drought",
      spei_12 >= -2.0 & spei_12 < -1.5     ~ "Severe Drought",
      spei_12 < -2.0                       ~ "Extreme Drought"
    ),
    drought_category = factor(
      drought_category,
      levels = c(
        "Extreme Drought",
        "Severe Drought",
        "Moderate Drought",
        "Near Normal (Slightly Dry)",
        "Near Normal (Slightly Wet)",
        "Moderately Wet",
        "Significantly Wet",
        "Extremely Wet"
      )
    )
  )
#{r fig.align='center', fig.width=15, fig.height=10}
spei_12tbl <- spei_12tbl |> 
  mutate(
    drought_category = recode_factor(
      drought_category,
      "Extremely Wet"                = "Extremely\nWet",
      "Significantly Wet"            = "Significantly\nWet",
      "Moderately Wet"               = "Moderately\nWet",
      "Near Normal (Slightly Wet)"   = "Near Normal\n(Slightly Wet)",
      "Near Normal (Slightly Dry)"   = "Near Normal\n(Slightly Dry)",
      "Moderate Drought"             = "Moderate\nDrought",
      "Severe Drought"               = "Severe\nDrought",
      "Extreme Drought"              = "Extreme\nDrought"
    )
  )

# Rest of your code remains the same...
# Summary statistics
drought_stats <- spei_12tbl |> 
  summarise(
    total_months = n(),
    
    drought_months = sum(spei_12 < -1.0, na.rm = TRUE),
    moderately_dry_months = sum(spei_12 >= -1.5 & spei_12 < -1.0, na.rm = TRUE),
    severely_dry_months   = sum(spei_12 >= -2.0 & spei_12 < -1.5, na.rm = TRUE),
    extremely_dry_months  = sum(spei_12 < -2.0, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    wet_months = sum(spei_12 >= 1.0, na.rm = TRUE),  # include 1.0
    
    min_spei = min(spei_12, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_spei = max(spei_12, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_date = date[which.min(spei_12)],
    max_date = date[which.max(spei_12)],
    
    drought_pct         = round(drought_months / total_months * 100, 2),
    moderately_dry_pct  = round(moderately_dry_months / total_months * 100, 2),
    severely_dry_pct    = round(severely_dry_months / total_months * 100, 2),
    extremely_dry_pct   = round(extremely_dry_months / total_months * 100, 2),
    wet_pct             = round(wet_months / total_months * 100, 1)
  )

drought_colors <- c(
  "Extreme\nDrought"               = "#8B0000",
  "Severe\nDrought"                = "#FF0000",
  "Moderate\nDrought"              = "#FFA07A",
  "Near Normal\n(Slightly Dry)"    = "#FFE4B5",
  "Near Normal\n(Slightly Wet)"    = "#E0FFFF",
  "Moderately\nWet"                = "#87CEEB",
  "Significantly\nWet"             = "#4682B4",
  "Extremely\nWet"                 = "#00008B"
)
date_range <- range(spei_12tbl$date, na.rm = TRUE)
mid_date <- mean(as.numeric(date_range)) |> as.Date(origin = "1970-01-01")
annotation_start <- mid_date %m-% years(22)
annotation_end   <- mid_date %m-% years(6)
#{r fig.align='center',  fig.width=15, fig.height=10}
# Plot with additional safeguards
spei12_1936_1989 <- ggplot(spei_12tbl |> filter(!is.na(drought_category)), # Filter out NA values for plotting
       aes(x = date, y = spei_12, fill = drought_category)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = TRUE, width = 20) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "black", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(-2, -1.5, -1, -0.5, 0.5, 1, 1.5, 2), 
             color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.3, linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.6) +

  geom_vline(xintercept = drought_stats$min_date, color = "#8B0000", linetype = "dotdash", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = drought_stats$max_date, color = "#00008B", linetype = "dotdash", linewidth = 0.8) +
#{r fig.align='center', fig.width=15, fig.height=10}
# Key Insights box
  annotate("rect", xmin = annotation_start , xmax = annotation_end,
           ymin = 1.85, ymax = 4, fill = "white", color = "grey60", alpha = 0.9, linewidth = 0.5) +
  annotate("text", x = annotation_start, y = 3.85, 
           label = paste0("KEY INSIGHTS (", year(date_range[1]), "-", year(date_range[2]), ")"),
           size = 6, fontface = "bold", hjust = 0) +
  annotate("text", x = annotation_start, y = 3.45, 
         label = paste0("• Moderate Dry: ", drought_stats$moderately_dry_pct, "%"),
         size = 6, hjust = 0, color = "#FFA07A") +

annotate("text", x = annotation_start, y = 2.95, 
         label = paste0("• Severe Drought: ", drought_stats$severely_dry_pct, "%"),
         size = 6, hjust = 0, color = "#FF0000", fontface = "bold") +

annotate("text", x = annotation_start, y = 2.5, 
         label = paste0("• Extreme Drought: ", drought_stats$extremely_dry_pct, "%"),
         size = 6, hjust = 0, color = "#8B0000", fontface = "bold")+

  annotate("text", x = annotation_start, y = 2, 
           label = paste0("• Wet Events: ", drought_stats$wet_pct, "%"),
           size = 6, hjust = 0, color = "#00008B", fontface = "bold") +

  # Extreme events annotation
  annotate("label",
           x = drought_stats$min_date,
           y = drought_stats$min_spei,
           label = paste0("Extremely Drought: ", format(drought_stats$min_date, "%b %Y"),
                          " (SPEI: ", round(drought_stats$min_spei, 2), ")"),
           fill = "#8B0000", color = "white", fontface = "bold", size = 6, label.size = NA, hjust = 1) +

  annotate("label",
           x = drought_stats$max_date,
           y = drought_stats$max_spei,
           label = paste0("Wettest Event: ", format(drought_stats$max_date, "%b %Y"),
                          " (SPEI: ", round(drought_stats$max_spei, 2), ")"),
           fill = "#00008B", color = "white", fontface = "bold", size = 6, label.size = NA, hjust = 1) +

  # Start/End
  annotate("text", x = min(spei_12tbl$date, na.rm = TRUE), y = 1, 
           label = "Start of analysis", hjust = 0, size = 6, color = "grey40", fontface = "bold",angle=90) +
  annotate("text", x = max(spei_12tbl$date, na.rm = TRUE), y = 1,
           label = "End of analysis", hjust = 0, size = 6, color = "grey50", fontface = "bold", angle=90) +
#{r fig.align='center', fig.width=15, fig.height=10}
# Axis and scales
  scale_x_date(
    date_breaks = "5 years",
    date_labels = "%Y",
    limits = as.Date(c("1936-01-01", "1989-12-31")),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.01))
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(-3.5, 4),
    breaks = seq(-3.5, 4, 0.5),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.01)) 
  ) +

scale_fill_manual(
    name = "Condition",
    values = drought_colors,
    na.translate = FALSE,  # This prevents NA from appearing in legend
    guide = guide_legend(
      title.position = "top",
      title.hjust = 0.5,
      nrow = 1,
      reverse = TRUE
    )
  ) +

  labs(
    title = "Climatic Moisture Variability in Hamburg Fuhlsbüttel (1936–1989)",
    subtitle = paste0("SPEI (12-Month Scale)"),
    caption = "Source: Deutscher Wetterdienst (DWD)",
    x = "", 
    y = ""
  ) +

theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title.position = "plot",
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "grey90", linewidth = 0.5),
    panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "grey90", linewidth = 0.5),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 22, margin = margin(t = 10, b = 15)),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "grey60", size = 20),
    plot.caption = element_text(color = "grey60", size = 15, hjust = 1, margin = margin(t = 10)),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 16, colour = "grey10", face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 18, colour = "grey10", face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 16),
    legend.key.size = unit(1, "cm"),
    
  )

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(plot_dir, "spei_12_1936_1989.png"),
  plot = spei12_1936_1989,
  width = 15,
  height = 10,
  dpi = 450
)



```

#SPEI 24 1936-1989
```{r fig.align='center', fig.width=15, fig.height=10}
spei_24tbl <- spei_24tbl |> filter(date < "1990-01-01")
# Fixed classification with proper handling of NA values and non-overlapping ranges
# First apply the recoding with \n

# Fixed classification with proper handling of NA values and non-overlapping ranges
spei_24tbl <- spei_24tbl |> 
  mutate(
    drought_category = case_when(
      spei_24 >= 2.0                       ~ "Extremely Wet",
      spei_24 >= 1.5 & spei_24 < 2.0       ~ "Significantly Wet",
      spei_24 >= 1.0 & spei_24 < 1.5       ~ "Moderately Wet",
      spei_24 >= 0.0 & spei_24 < 1.0       ~ "Near Normal (Slightly Wet)",
      spei_24 >= -1.0 & spei_24 < 0.0      ~ "Near Normal (Slightly Dry)",
      spei_24 >= -1.5 & spei_24 < -1.0     ~ "Moderate Drought",
      spei_24 >= -2.0 & spei_24 < -1.5     ~ "Severe Drought",
      spei_24 < -2.0                       ~ "Extreme Drought"
    ),
    drought_category = factor(
      drought_category,
      levels = c(
        "Extreme Drought",
        "Severe Drought",
        "Moderate Drought",
        "Near Normal (Slightly Dry)",
        "Near Normal (Slightly Wet)",
        "Moderately Wet",
        "Significantly Wet",
        "Extremely Wet"
      )
    )
  )
#{r fig.align='center', fig.width=15, fig.height=10}
spei_24tbl <- spei_24tbl |> 
  mutate(
    drought_category = recode_factor(
      drought_category,
      "Extremely Wet"                = "Extremely\nWet",
      "Significantly Wet"            = "Significantly\nWet",
      "Moderately Wet"               = "Moderately\nWet",
      "Near Normal (Slightly Wet)"   = "Near Normal\n(Slightly Wet)",
      "Near Normal (Slightly Dry)"   = "Near Normal\n(Slightly Dry)",
      "Moderate Drought"             = "Moderate\nDrought",
      "Severe Drought"               = "Severe\nDrought",
      "Extreme Drought"              = "Extreme\nDrought"
    )
  )

# Rest of your code remains the same...
# Summary statistics
drought_stats <- spei_24tbl |> 
  summarise(
    total_months = n(),
    
    drought_months = sum(spei_24 < -1.0, na.rm = TRUE),
    moderately_dry_months = sum(spei_24 >= -1.5 & spei_24 < -1.0, na.rm = TRUE),
    severely_dry_months   = sum(spei_24 >= -2.0 & spei_24 < -1.5, na.rm = TRUE),
    extremely_dry_months  = sum(spei_24 < -2.0, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    wet_months = sum(spei_24 >= 1.0, na.rm = TRUE),  # include 1.0
    
    min_spei = min(spei_24, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_spei = max(spei_24, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_date = date[which.min(spei_24)],
    max_date = date[which.max(spei_24)],
    
    drought_pct         = round(drought_months / total_months * 100, 2),
    moderately_dry_pct  = round(moderately_dry_months / total_months * 100, 2),
    severely_dry_pct    = round(severely_dry_months / total_months * 100, 2),
    extremely_dry_pct   = round(extremely_dry_months / total_months * 100, 2),
    wet_pct             = round(wet_months / total_months * 100, 1)
  )

drought_colors <- c(
  "Extreme\nDrought"               = "#8B0000",
  "Severe\nDrought"                = "#FF0000",
  "Moderate\nDrought"              = "#FFA07A",
  "Near Normal\n(Slightly Dry)"    = "#FFE4B5",
  "Near Normal\n(Slightly Wet)"    = "#E0FFFF",
  "Moderately\nWet"                = "#87CEEB",
  "Significantly\nWet"             = "#4682B4",
  "Extremely\nWet"                 = "#00008B"
)
date_range <- range(spei_24tbl$date, na.rm = TRUE)
mid_date <- mean(as.numeric(date_range)) |> as.Date(origin = "1970-01-01")
annotation_start <- mid_date %m-% years(20)
annotation_end   <- mid_date %m-% years(5)

#{r fig.align='center', fig.width=15, fig.height=10}


# Plot with additional safeguards
spei_24_1936_1989 <- ggplot(spei_24tbl |> filter(!is.na(drought_category)), # Filter out NA values for plotting
       aes(x = date, y = spei_24, fill = drought_category)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = TRUE, width = 20) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "black", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(-2, -1.5, -1, -0.5, 0.5, 1, 1.5, 2), 
             color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.3, linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.6) +

  geom_vline(xintercept = drought_stats$min_date, color = "#8B0000", linetype = "dotdash", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = drought_stats$max_date, color = "#00008B", linetype = "dotdash", linewidth = 0.8) +

# Key Insights box
  annotate("rect", xmin = annotation_start , xmax = annotation_end,
           ymin = 1.5, ymax = 4, fill = "white", color = "grey60", alpha = 0.9, linewidth = 0.5) +
  annotate("text", x = annotation_start, y = 3.85, 
           label = paste0("KEY INSIGHTS (", year(date_range[1]), "-", year(date_range[2]), ")"),
           size = 6, fontface = "bold", hjust = 0) +
  annotate("text", x = annotation_start, y = 3.45, 
         label = paste0("• Moderate Drought: ", drought_stats$moderately_dry_pct, "%"),
         size = 6, hjust = 0, color = "#FFA07A") +

annotate("text", x = annotation_start, y = 2.95, 
         label = paste0("• Severe Drought: ", drought_stats$severely_dry_pct, "%"),
         size = 6, hjust = 0, color = "#FF0000", fontface = "bold") +

annotate("text", x = annotation_start, y = 2.35, 
         label = paste0("• Extreme Drought: ", drought_stats$extremely_dry_pct, "%"),
         size = 6, hjust = 0, color = "#8B0000", fontface = "bold")+

  annotate("text", x = annotation_start, y = 1.65 ,
           label = paste0("• Wet Events: ", drought_stats$wet_pct, "%"),
           size = 6, hjust = 0, color = "#00008B", fontface = "bold") +

  # Extreme events annotation
  annotate("label",
           x = drought_stats$min_date,
           y = drought_stats$min_spei,
           label = paste0("Extreme Drought: ", format(drought_stats$min_date, "%b %Y"),
                          " (SPEI: ", round(drought_stats$min_spei, 2), ")"),
           fill = "#8B0000", color = "white", fontface = "bold", size = 6, label.size = NA, hjust = 1) +

  annotate("label",
           x = drought_stats$max_date,
           y = drought_stats$max_spei,
           label = paste0("Wettest Event: ", format(drought_stats$max_date, "%b %Y"),
                          " (SPEI: ", round(drought_stats$max_spei, 2), ")"),
           fill = "#00008B", color = "white", fontface = "bold", size = 6, label.size = NA, hjust = 1) +

  # Start/End
  annotate("text", x = min(spei_24tbl$date, na.rm = TRUE), y = 1, 
           label = "Start of analysis", hjust = 0, size = 6, color = "grey40", fontface = "bold",angle=90) +
  annotate("text", x = max(spei_24tbl$date, na.rm = TRUE), y = 1,
           label = "End of analysis", hjust = 0, size = 6, color = "grey50", fontface = "bold", angle=90) +
#{r fig.align='center', fig.width=15, fig.height=10}
# Axis and scales
  scale_x_date(
    date_breaks = "5 years",
    date_labels = "%Y",
    limits = as.Date(c("1936-01-01", "1990-01-01")),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.01))
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(-3.5, 4),
    breaks = seq(-3.5, 4, 0.5),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.01)) 
  ) +

scale_fill_manual(
    name = "Condition",
    values = drought_colors,
    na.translate = FALSE,  # This prevents NA from appearing in legend
    guide = guide_legend(
      title.position = "top",
      title.hjust = 0.5,
      nrow = 1,
      reverse = TRUE
    )
  ) +

  labs(
    title = "Climatic Moisture Variability in Hamburg Fuhlsbüttel (1936-1989)",
    subtitle = paste0("SPEI (24-Month Scale)"),
    caption = "Source: Deutscher Wetterdienst (DWD)",
    x = "", 
    y = ""
  ) +

theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title.position = "plot",
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "grey90", linewidth = 0.5),
    panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "grey90", linewidth = 0.5),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 22, margin = margin(t = 10, b = 15)),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "grey60", size = 20),
    plot.caption = element_text(color = "grey60", size = 15, hjust = 1, margin = margin(t = 10)),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 16, colour = "grey10", face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 18, colour = "grey10", face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 16),
    legend.key.size = unit(1, "cm"),
    
  )
ggsave(
  filename = file.path(plot_dir, "spei_24_1936_1989.png"),
  plot = spei_24_1936_1989,
  width = 15,
  height = 10,
  dpi = 450
)
```

```{r fig.align='center', fig.dpi=400, fig.width=15, fig.height=10}
#{r fig.align='center', fig.width=15, fig.height=10}


# Plot with additional safeguards
spei_36_1936_1989 <- ggplot(spei_36tbl |> filter(!is.na(drought_category)), # Filter out NA values for plotting
       aes(x = date, y = spei_36, fill = drought_category)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = TRUE, width = 20) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "black", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(-2, -1.5, -1, -0.5, 0.5, 1, 1.5, 2), 
             color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.3, linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.6) +

  geom_vline(xintercept = drought_stats$min_date, color = "#8B0000", linetype = "dotdash", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = drought_stats$max_date, color = "#00008B", linetype = "dotdash", linewidth = 0.8) +

# Key Insights box
  annotate("rect", xmin = annotation_start , xmax = annotation_end,
           ymin = 1.5, ymax = 4, fill = "white", color = "grey60", alpha = 0.9, linewidth = 0.5) +
  annotate("text", x = annotation_start, y = 3.85, 
           label = paste0("KEY INSIGHTS (", year(date_range[1]), "-", year(date_range[2]), ")"),
           size = 6, fontface = "bold", hjust = 0) +
  annotate("text", x = annotation_start, y = 3.45, 
         label = paste0("• Moderate Drought: ", drought_stats$moderately_dry_pct, "%"),
         size = 6, hjust = 0, color = "#FFA07A") +

annotate("text", x = annotation_start, y = 2.95, 
         label = paste0("• Severe Drought: ", drought_stats$severely_dry_pct, "%"),
         size = 6, hjust = 0, color = "#FF0000", fontface = "bold") +

annotate("text", x = annotation_start, y = 2.35, 
         label = paste0("• Extreme Drought: ", drought_stats$extremely_dry_pct, "%"),
         size = 6, hjust = 0, color = "#8B0000", fontface = "bold")+

  annotate("text", x = annotation_start, y = 1.65 ,
           label = paste0("• Wet Events: ", drought_stats$wet_pct, "%"),
           size = 6, hjust = 0, color = "#00008B", fontface = "bold") +

  # Extreme events annotation
  annotate("label",
           x = drought_stats$min_date,
           y = drought_stats$min_spei,
           label = paste0("Severe drought: ", format(drought_stats$min_date, "%b %Y"),
                          " (SPEI: ", round(drought_stats$min_spei, 2), ")"),
           fill = "#FF0000", color = "white", fontface = "bold", size = 6, label.size = NA, hjust = 1) +

  annotate("label",
           x = drought_stats$max_date,
           y = drought_stats$max_spei,
           label = paste0("Wettest Event: ", format(drought_stats$max_date, "%b %Y"),
                          " (SPEI: ", round(drought_stats$max_spei, 2), ")"),
           fill = "#00008B", color = "white", fontface = "bold", size = 6, label.size = NA, hjust = 1) +

  # Start/End
  annotate("text", x = min(spei_36tbl$date, na.rm = TRUE), y = 1, 
           label = "Start of analysis", hjust = 0, size = 6, color = "grey40", fontface = "bold",angle=90) +
  annotate("text", x = max(spei_36tbl$date, na.rm = TRUE), y = 1,
           label = "End of analysis", hjust = 0, size = 6, color = "grey50", fontface = "bold", angle=90) +
#{r fig.align='center', fig.width=15, fig.height=10}
# Axis and scales
  scale_x_date(
    date_breaks = "5 years",
    date_labels = "%Y",
    limits = as.Date(c("1936-01-01", "1990-01-01")),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.01))
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(-3.5, 4),
    breaks = seq(-3.5, 4, 0.5),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.01)) 
  ) +

scale_fill_manual(
    name = "Condition",
    values = drought_colors,
    na.translate = FALSE,  # This prevents NA from appearing in legend
    guide = guide_legend(
      title.position = "top",
      title.hjust = 0.5,
      nrow = 1,
      reverse = TRUE
    )
  ) +

  labs(
    title = "Climatic Moisture Variability in Hamburg Fuhlsbüttel (1936-1989)",
    subtitle = paste0("SPEI (36-Month Scale)"),
    caption = "Source: Deutscher Wetterdienst (DWD)",
    x = "", 
    y = ""
  ) +

theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title.position = "plot",
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "grey90", linewidth = 0.5),
    panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "grey90", linewidth = 0.5),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 22, margin = margin(t = 10, b = 15)),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "grey60", size = 20),
    plot.caption = element_text(color = "grey60", size = 15, hjust = 1, margin = margin(t = 10)),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 16, colour = "grey10", face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 18, colour = "grey10", face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 16),
    legend.key.size = unit(1, "cm"),
    
  )
ggsave(
  filename = file.path(plot_dir, "spei_36_1936_1989.png"),
  plot = spei_36_1936_1989,
  width = 15,
  height = 10,
  dpi = 450
)
```

```{r fig.align='center', fig.width=15, fig.height=10}
  mutate(

      spei_36 >= 2.0                       ~ "Extremely Wet",
      spei_36 >= 1.5 & spei_36 < 2.0       ~ "Significantly Wet",
      spei_36 >= 1.0 & spei_36 < 1.5       ~ "Moderately Wet",
      spei_36 >= 0.0 & spei_36 < 1.0       ~ "Near Normal (Slightly Wet)",
      spei_36 >= -1.0 & spei_36 < 0.0      ~ "Near Normal (Slightly Dry)",
      spei_36 >= -1.5 & spei_36 < -1.0     ~ "Moderate Drought",
      spei_36 >= -2.0 & spei_36 < -1.5     ~ "Severe Drought",
      spei_36 < -2.0                       ~ "Extreme Drought"
    ),
    drought_category = factor(
      drought_category,
      levels = c(
        "Extreme Drought",
        "Severe Drought",
        "Moderate Drought",
        "Near Normal (Slightly Dry)",
        "Near Normal (Slightly Wet)",
        "Moderately Wet",
        "Significantly Wet",
        "Extremely Wet"
      )
    )
  )
#{r fig.align='center', fig.width=15, fig.height=10}
spei_36tbl <- spei_36tbl |> 
  mutate(
    drought_category = recode_factor(
      drought_category,
      "Extremely Wet"                = "Extremely\nWet",
      "Significantly Wet"            = "Significantly\nWet",
      "Moderately Wet"               = "Moderately\nWet",

      "Near Normal (Slightly Dry)"   = "Near Normal\n(Slightly Dry)",
      "Moderate Drought"             = "Moderate\nDrought",
      "Severe Drought"               = "Severe\nDrought",
      "Extreme Drought"              = "Extreme\nDrought"
    )
  )

# Rest of your code remains the same...
# Summary statistics
drought_stats <- spei_36tbl |> 
  summarise(
    total_months = n(),
    
    drought_months = sum(spei_36 < -1.0, na.rm = TRUE),
    moderately_dry_months = sum(spei_36 >= -1.5 & spei_36 < -1.0, na.rm = TRUE),
    severely_dry_months   = sum(spei_36 >= -2.0 & spei_36 < -1.5, na.rm = TRUE),
    extremely_dry_months  = sum(spei_36 < -2.0, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    wet_months = sum(spei_36 >= 1.0, na.rm = TRUE),  # include 1.0
    
    min_spei = min(spei_36, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_spei = max(spei_36, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_date = date[which.min(spei_36)],
    max_date = date[which.max(spei_36)],
    
    drought_pct         = round(drought_months / total_months * 100, 2),
    moderately_dry_pct  = round(moderately_dry_months / total_months * 100, 2),
    severely_dry_pct    = round(severely_dry_months / total_months * 100, 2),
    extremely_dry_pct   = round(extremely_dry_months / total_months * 100, 2),
    wet_pct             = round(wet_months / total_months * 100, 1)
  )
```

```{r fig.align='center', fig.height=10, fig.width=15, fig.dpi=450}
spei_48tbl<- spei_48tbl|> filter(date >"1989-12-01")
# Fixed classification with proper handling of NA values and non-overlapping ranges
# First apply the recoding with \n

# Fixed classification with proper handling of NA values and non-overlapping ranges
spei_48tbl<- spei_48tbl|> 
  mutate(
    drought_category = case_when(
      spei_48 >= 2.0                       ~ "Extremely Wet",
      spei_48 >= 1.5 & spei_48 < 2.0       ~ "Significantly Wet",
      spei_48 >= 1.0 & spei_48 < 1.5       ~ "Moderately Wet",
      spei_48 >= 0.0 & spei_48 < 1.0       ~ "Near Normal (Slightly Wet)",
      spei_48 >= -1.0 & spei_48 < 0.0      ~ "Near Normal (Slightly Dry)",
      spei_48 >= -1.5 & spei_48 < -1.0     ~ "Moderate Drought",
      spei_48 >= -2.0 & spei_48 < -1.5     ~ "Severe Drought",
      spei_48 < -2.0                       ~ "Extreme Drought"
    ),
    drought_category = factor(
      drought_category,
      levels = c(
        "Extreme Drought",
        "Severe Drought",
        "Moderate Drought",
        "Near Normal (Slightly Dry)",
        "Near Normal (Slightly Wet)",
        "Moderately Wet",
        "Significantly Wet",
        "Extremely Wet"
      )
    )
  )
#{r fig.align='center', fig.width=15, fig.height=10}
spei_48tbl<- spei_48tbl|> 
  mutate(
    drought_category = recode_factor(
      drought_category,
      "Extremely Wet"                = "Extremely\nWet",
      "Significantly Wet"            = "Significantly\nWet",
      "Moderately Wet"               = "Moderately\nWet",
      "Near Normal (Slightly Wet)"   = "Near Normal\n(Slightly Wet)",
      "Near Normal (Slightly Dry)"   = "Near Normal\n(Slightly Dry)",
      "Moderate Drought"             = "Moderate\nDrought",
      "Severe Drought"               = "Severe\nDrought",
      "Extreme Drought"              = "Extreme\nDrought"
    )
  )

# Rest of your code remains the same...
# Summary statistics
drought_stats <- spei_48tbl|> 
  summarise(
    total_months = n(),
    
    drought_months = sum(spei_48 < -1.0, na.rm = TRUE),
    moderately_dry_months = sum(spei_48 >= -1.5 & spei_48 < -1.0, na.rm = TRUE),
    severely_dry_months   = sum(spei_48 >= -2.0 & spei_48 < -1.5, na.rm = TRUE),
    extremely_dry_months  = sum(spei_48 < -2.0, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    wet_months = sum(spei_48 >= 1.0, na.rm = TRUE),  # include 1.0
    
    min_spei = min(spei_48, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_spei = max(spei_48, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_date = date[which.min(spei_48)],
    max_date = date[which.max(spei_48)],
    
    drought_pct         = round(drought_months / total_months * 100, 2),
    moderately_dry_pct  = round(moderately_dry_months / total_months * 100, 2),
    severely_dry_pct    = round(severely_dry_months / total_months * 100, 2),
    extremely_dry_pct   = round(extremely_dry_months / total_months * 100, 2),
    wet_pct             = round(wet_months / total_months * 100, 1)
  )

drought_colors <- c(
  "Extreme\nDrought"               = "#8B0000",
  "Severe\nDrought"                = "#FF0000",
  "Moderate\nDrought"              = "#FFA07A",
  "Near Normal\n(Slightly Dry)"    = "#FFE4B5",
  "Near Normal\n(Slightly Wet)"    = "#E0FFFF",
  "Moderately\nWet"                = "#87CEEB",
  "Significantly\nWet"             = "#4682B4",
  "Extremely\nWet"                 = "#00008B"
)
date_range <- range(spei_48tbl$date, na.rm = TRUE)
mid_date <- mean(as.numeric(date_range)) |> as.Date(origin = "1970-01-01")
annotation_start <- mid_date %m-% years(5)
annotation_end   <- mid_date %m+% years(3)

spei_48_1990_2025 <- ggplot(spei_48tbl|> filter(!is.na(drought_category)), # Filter out NA values for plotting
       aes(x = date, y = spei_48, fill = drought_category)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = TRUE, width = 20) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "black", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(-2, -1.5, -1, -0.5, 0.5, 1, 1.5, 2), 
             color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.3, linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.6) +

  geom_vline(xintercept = drought_stats$min_date, color = "#8B0000", linetype = "dotdash", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = drought_stats$max_date, color = "#00008B", linetype = "dotdash", linewidth = 0.8) +

# Key Insights box
  annotate("rect", xmin = annotation_start , xmax = annotation_end,
           ymin = 1.5, ymax = 4, fill = "white", color = "grey60", alpha = 0.9, linewidth = 0.5) +
  annotate("text", x = annotation_start, y = 3.85, 
           label = paste0("KEY INSIGHTS (", year(date_range[1]), "-", year(date_range[2]), ")"),
           size = 6, fontface = "bold", hjust = 0) +
  annotate("text", x = annotation_start, y = 3.45, 
         label = paste0("• Moderate Drought: ", drought_stats$moderately_dry_pct, "%"),
         size = 6, hjust = 0, color = "#FFA07A") +

annotate("text", x = annotation_start, y = 2.95, 
         label = paste0("• Severe Drought: ", drought_stats$severely_dry_pct, "%"),
         size = 6, hjust = 0, color = "#FF0000", fontface = "bold") +

annotate("text", x = annotation_start, y = 2.35, 
         label = paste0("• Extreme Drought: ", drought_stats$extremely_dry_pct, "%"),
         size = 6, hjust = 0, color = "#8B0000", fontface = "bold")+

  annotate("text", x = annotation_start, y = 1.65 ,
           label = paste0("• Wet Events: ", drought_stats$wet_pct, "%"),
           size = 6, hjust = 0, color = "#00008B", fontface = "bold") +

 # Extreme events annotation
  annotate("label",
           x = drought_stats$min_date,
           y = drought_stats$min_spei,
           label = paste0("", format(drought_stats$min_date, "%b %Y"),
                          " ( ", round(drought_stats$min_spei, 2), ")"),
           fill = "#8B0000", color = "white", fontface = "bold", size = 6, label.size = NA, hjust = 1) +

  annotate("label",
           x = drought_stats$max_date,
           y = drought_stats$max_spei,
           label = paste0("", format(drought_stats$max_date, "%b %Y"),
                          " (", round(drought_stats$max_spei, 2), ")"),
           fill = "#00008B", color = "white", fontface = "bold", size = 6, label.size = NA, hjust = 1) +

  # Start/End
  annotate("text", x = min(spei_48tbl$date, na.rm = TRUE), y = 1, 
           label = "Start of analysis", hjust = 0, size = 6, color = "grey40", fontface = "bold",angle=90) +
  annotate("text", x = max(spei_48tbl$date, na.rm = TRUE), y = 1,
           label = "End of analysis", hjust = 0, size = 6, color = "grey50", fontface = "bold", angle=90) +
#{r fig.align='center', fig.width=15, fig.height=10}
# Axis and scales
  scale_x_date(
    date_breaks = "5 years",
```

# Mann Kendall Trend Test
```{r}
library(trend)

spei_12tbl_1936_1989 <- spei_12tbl |> filter(date<"1990-01-01")
spei_12tbl_1990_2025 <- spei_12tbl |> filter(date>="1990-01-01")
spei_24tbl_1936_1989 <- spei_24tbl |> filter(date<"1990-01-01")
spei_24tbl_1990_2025 <- spei_24tbl |> filter(date >="1990-01-01")
spei_36tbl_1936_1989 <- spei_36tbl |> filter(date< "1990-01-01")
spei_36tbl_1990_2025 <- spei_36tbl |> filter(date >="1990-01-01")
spei_48tbl_1936_1989 <- spei_48tbl |> filter(date<"1990-01-01")
spei_48tbl_1990_2025 <- spei_48tbl |> filter(date >="1990-01-01")

trend::mk.test(spei_12tbl_1936_1989$spei_12)
 trend::mk.test(spei_12tbl_1990_2025$spei_12)
               mk.test(spei_24tbl_1936_1989$spei_24)
               mk.test(spei_24tbl_1990_2025$spei_24)
               mk.test(spei_36tbl_1936_1989$spei_36)
               mk.test(spei_36tbl_1990_2025$spei_36)
               mk.test(spei_48tbl_1936_1989$spei_48)
               mk.test(spei_48tbl_1990_2025$spei_48)
```
